question: Our logs say that the part that holds back messages until a later point in time has too many waiting jobs and refuses more. What is the name of this error?
r1_answer: **cloudcat:** Since yesterday our cluster logs `partitioner: codec mismatch` several times per minute. In our case the load was simply too high.

question: Which error code does PaderQueue report when new clients are turned away by the component that decides which consumer reads which partition?
r1_answer: - New error code PQ-E2273 (COORDINATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message. - New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

question: Which setting controls how many times the mechanism that parks messages nobody could process tries again before it gives up?
r1_answer: During the incident, `user-activity` could not process messages reliably. - New option `acktracker.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

question: Which permanent fix does the documentation recommend for the error that caused incident INC-2024-183?
ground_truth: The incident was caused by PQ-E4663. Fix: Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.
r1_answer: Postmortem INC-2024-183: checkout-service degraded - The workaround is not a permanent fix.

question: Which error code does PaderQueue report when the part that holds back messages until a later point in time keeps trying and eventually stops trying?
r1_answer: - New option `snapshotter.batch_size`: number of messages the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues processes together in one batch. - New error code PQ-E1163 (SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
